items.title: Red Light Green Light Mobs
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Red light STOP! Green light GO! Immerse yourself into this recreation of a classic game whilst playing as a mob. Test your steady skills and see if you can make it across the line without moving and being caught by the Watcher. 

Play as a Zombie in the Overworld, a Hoglin in the Nether and an Enderman in the End.

items.title: The Secret Island
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Explore an island lost in time, away from all civilization in the center of an ocean! Discover a giant temple that lays untouched and hidden in secret for hundreds of years and claim its loot!

- By inPixel

items.title: The Mystery of the Budokan
items.creator: The Wizard and Wyld
items.description: This world has 8 different quests based on judo's core values; courage, friendship, self-control, modesty, sincerity, respect, politeness & honour. Learn about judo & build a better world.

items.title: Pyjamas Party
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Get your colorful pajamas ready for the best pajama party in town! Choose between 12 unique onesie designs and styles. It's Friday night, and all of your friends are hanging out, having a great time. So grab your snacks, brush your teeth, and get ready for movie night at the best sleepover in town!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Cute Aliens
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Cool and cute space alien skins! Roleplay as an otherworldly space being! Which alien skin is your favorite?

items.title: Mob Gamer Party
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Assemble the squad! This team of mob gamers are in it to win it. Can you keep up?

items.title: Aurora Falls
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: We're proud to introduce you to Aurora Falls, the latest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics and the first to include our brand new Core Pack, jam packed with awesome new content, including new blocks, animals, furniture, foods, even a new tree! We've crammed more great stuff in here than we can list here, so you'll have to explore!

items.title: Kawaii Cafe
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Join us for a cupcake in the Kawaii Cafe! Put on your most pastel-coloured clothes and take your friends on a cute trip.

- 8 HD Aesthetic skins!
- Free skin: Akira
- Aesthetic, Pastel & Cute!

By CubeCraft

items.title: Patternz
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Show off your fashion with this unique pack. This pack offers a wide range of designs that aren't seen anywhere else. Which is your favorite?

items.title: Icetopia
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Winter is coming and it's going to be a cold one. Join the ice queen in her attempts to build the perfect utopia for winter lovers. Do you have what it takes to withstand the cold?

items.title: Lucky Block Party
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Lucky Block Party is a world filled with lots of lucky blocks!
There are endless outcomes when you break these mysterious lucky blocks. One outcome might be positive while another might harm you! Can you defeat the Ender Dragon with the random loot you gather? Have fun!

+ Single player or multiplayer

items.title: Which mob are you?
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Which mob are you? Take the quiz to find out!
+ Supports English, German, French and Spanish
+ Fun quiz
+ Multiplayer friendly
+ Skyblock

items.title: Lucky Block Race
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play alone or with friends in a race full of chaos. Open all lucky blocks and be the first to reach the finish line. Can you improve your personal record in the race to the finish?

- Custom timer and reset the system.
- Play with friends or alone.
- Three types of lucky blocks.

Made by Block Studios and Mine-North.

items.title: Stylish Autumn Teens
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Become super cozy in these Autumn Holiday skins and show off your fashionable fall colors! You will be cute and festive all throughout the season! 

- 10 cozy teen skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Neon Destroyers
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: The time has come to rule with Neon Destroyers! From slime-dripping monsters to energy-filled terrors, put on your frightening face and triumph in all that you do. These spooky skins will surely send shivers down your spine!

items.title: HD Block Disguise
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Play the ultimate game of hide and seek with this collection of 40 HD block camos! Blend into your surroundings, and be the winner as you choose from this wide section of disguises!

items.title: Zombies
items.creator: Tristan Productions
items.description:
Salvage food and weapons from the carcasses of civilization. Fight off waves of torturous ZOMBIES in the crumbling ruins of an ancient city. Tremendous power awaits you... but only if you're bold enough to seize it.
+ Custom ZOMBIES
+ Multiplayer or singleplayer
+ Unique WEAPONS and ARMOR
+ 15 DEADLY waves
+ Apocalyptic city
+ FUN missions
+ 10 HD skins
Watch the TRAILER

items.title: Neon Mobs
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Have you seen these mobs covered in neon? They are absolutely cool and eye catching! Now choose your favorite mob skin and spice things up a bit!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Mob themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Sweater Weather
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Life is simply better while wearing a sweater. It's time to put on a stylish sweater to show off to all of your friends!

+ 12 skins
+ Perfect for winter

items.title: Urban Outfits
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Want to stand out from the crowd? These awesome skins are sure to make you stand out among your friends!

+ 12 teen skins
+ Extremely stylish urban outfits

items.title: Parkour to Heaven
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Did you just find the stairway to heaven? Sign me up! Let's walk the path to reach the gates of heaven today and take the leap of faith!

items.title: Chickens
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Cluck! It's time to become one of the coolest chickens around with these amazing skins!

+ 7 crazy chicken types
+ Unique outfits

items.title: LASERS
items.creator: Volcano
items.description:
Get lasers from point A to point B. Sounds easy, but it's surprisingly difficult!
Solve challenging puzzles in a laser labyrinth. Put your brain to the test with 40 levels of LASERS now!

items.title: Sky Life Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Roam the blissful air with the many uniquely themed biomes. To have fun with pals or alone, employ your leap powers and explore!

-Multiplayer Supportive
-Beautiful Builds
